do_not_use_when: User only needs raw evidence fetching.
arifos_manifest.eureka_insight: Cleverness without correctness is dangerous (G-Score). The agent must think within the constitutional box.

mode_purpose.atlas: Cognitive atlas / map of reasoning zones for the query.
mode_purpose.axioms: List available constitutional axioms and their confidence.
mode_purpose.metabolize: Metabolize evidence/receipts into a structured mind state.
mode_purpose.plan: Generate a governed execution plan (PlanReceipt) with task_graph and reversibility_map (H2).
mode_purpose.plan_approve: Approve a pending plan so it can be used by arif_forge (H2).
mode_purpose.plan_review: Retrieve an existing plan by plan_id.
mode_purpose.reason: General constitutional reasoning with explicit axiom trace.
mode_purpose.refactor_plan: Refactor an existing plan_id into a tighter task_graph.
mode_purpose.reflect: Introspective replay of prior reasoning steps.
mode_purpose.simulate: Simulate outcomes of a candidate without mutation.
mode_purpose.verify: Truth-check a specific claim against the constitution.
mode_purpose.wonder: Open-ended generative exploration under F7 humility bounds.

purpose: Evaluates claims using explicit F1–L13 axioms.
use_when: User asks for governed reasoning or constitutional analysis.
A claim, plan, or decision needs axiom-based evaluation.

description: Execute structured reasoning and plan formulation. Decomposes inquiries into verified derivations. Modes: reason (inquiry breakdown), plan (drafting multi-step execution steps), verify (logical proof check). Requires valid session credentials. Outputs: structured reasoning record.

actor_id.description: Your agent identity, e.g. 'kimi-code/FI-008' or 'claude/sonnet'. Recorded in the audit log so this action is attributed to you.

mode.description: 'reason' (default) — decompose a question; 'reflect' — self-review of prior reasoning; 'verify' — check a derivation; 'axioms' — surface hidden assumptions; 'plan'/'plan_review'/'plan_approve'/'refactor_plan' — execution-plan lifecycle; 'metabolize' — consolidate past reasoning; 'simulate' — what-if; 'wonder' — open exploration; 'atlas' — map the problem space.

plan_id.description: Plan reference from an earlier plan-mode response — needed for the review/approve/refactor steps.

query.description: The question, claim, or problem to reason about, in plain language.

session_id.description: Session id returned by arif_init (looks like 'sess-…'). Pass it on every call after init so the action is attributed to your governed session.

session_token.description: Session Continuity Token (SCT) — the credential string arif_init returned alongside session_id. Pass it back on follow-up calls to prove the session is yours; without it the kernel treats you as unauthenticated.

witness_type.description: Who vouches for the reasoning record: 'ai' (default), 'human', or 'external' system.
